title: Global NCAP (Safer Cars for Africa, 10 Nov 2026): the India-made Renault Kiger, tested as sold in South Africa, scored 2 stars adult with two airbags and no ESC or ISOFIX; after Renault made six airbags, ESC and ISOFIX standard and volunteered the upgraded car it scored 4 stars adult (25.20/34) and 3 stars child (30.21/49). Bodyshell and footwell unstable; one door opened in the side impact; front chests marginal; 3-year-old dummy zero side points; 18-month-old full protection; no passenger-airbag cut-off switch. Not an India rating. In India the Kiger starts at Rs 5.81 lakh ex-showroom with six airbags and ESP standard.
